darstellung.alle_module: Use the same design for all modules
darstellung.einleitung: One design profile for LifePlanner and all modules. The profiles are identical to BudgetManager's, so the same colours apply everywhere.
darstellung.sprache_hinweis: Applies to LifePlanner itself. Modules carry their own language setting.
darstellung.uebernahme_hinweis: Modules receive the profile when they start. LifePlanner itself switches immediately.
darstellung.vorschau_hinweis: This is how tiles, buttons and notes look with this profile.

haupt.bridge_hinweis: FPM only ever writes reviewable proposals. BudgetManager takes them over after approval in the import inbox. The central updater updates core and modules separately, without coupling their databases.
haupt.integration_einleitung: Modules exchange reviewable files and events only - never direct SQL access.
haupt.start_einleitung: Profile: {profil} · Pick a module and carry on.
haupt.system_einleitung: Central paths, backup and diagnostics of the LifePlanner core.

module.deinstallation_hinweis: LifePlanner will close, remove the module with a rollback backup, and start again afterwards.
module.download_laeuft_hinweis: A module is already being downloaded from GitHub.
module.einleitung: Install signed .lpmodule packages, or unsigned ones you explicitly trust, update modules from the central catalogue, or remove program files only. Profile data survives an uninstall.
module.github_abfrage: Querying GitHub repositories for stable, matching .lpmodule releases …
module.installation_hinweis: Program files and profile data are backed up before installation. On failure everything is rolled back automatically.
module.kein_passendes_paket: The official repositories currently hold no matching .lpmodule for this operating system.
module.pruefung_laeuft_hinweis: A module package is already being checked.
module.sicherheitshinweis: Security: a module is executable code and currently runs with the rights of your user account; an operating-system sandbox is not yet in place. The LifePlanner permissions it declares are shown beforehand. Install even signed packages only from a publisher you trust. Installation and removal use a backup and can be rolled back.

updates.alles_aktuell: The LifePlanner core and all known modules are up to date.
updates.einleitung: LifePlanner checks the core, installed modules and new modules from the signed online catalogue together. Every component is verified, cached, and installed only after a rollback backup.
updates.installationshinweis: Open modules are shut down in an orderly way during installation. Unsaved input in a module therefore has to be saved beforehand. Profile data and program files get separate rollback backups.
updates.keine_auswahl_hinweis: Select at least one available component.
updates.quelle_fehlt_hinweis: Please enter the URL of the central update manifest.
updates.vorbereitet_hinweis: Update prepared. LifePlanner will now close; the external helper installs all selected components and restarts it.
updates.wird_installiert_hinweis: All selected components have been verified. LifePlanner will now close and restart automatically after the update.
